args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. At the time of the incident, all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) were running v2.3.1, with an error rate of 0.18 and the service reported unhealthy. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent production release that was healthy, in all production regions. The rollback is verified: all three regions now run v2.3.0. v2.3.1 was previously deployed to production and marked unhealthy. A v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging. Follow-up: confirm checkout-api recovers on v2.3.0 and investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy. The bad release was v2.3.1, which was live in all regions with an error rate of 0.18.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer.

I haven't confirmed that the error rate has dropped on v2.3.0 yet. Checking that is the next step. The incident also lists a follow-up to investigate the v2.3.1 regression before it is redeployed. The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging.
